Helvina.definition: Helvīna ae, f a surname of Ceres, Iu.

habens.definition: habēns adj. P. of habeo, owning, rich .—As subst m. : invidere habenti, V.

habitans.definition: (habitāns, ntis) m P. of habito, an inhabitant ; only plur gen. : habitantum, O.

habitudo.definition: habitūdō inis, f 1 habitus, condition, appearance : corporis! T.

haesitans.definition: haesitāns ntis, adj. P. of haesito, stammering : verba.

hau1.definition: 'hau (au) interj. (of pain or grief), Oh! ah! T.'

haudquaquam.definition: haud-quāquam or haud quāquam by no means whatever, not at all: haud quaquam id est difficile Crasso: mediocre: par gloria, S.: certamine ambiguo, L.: dictis violentia Turni Flectitur, V.

hedychrum.definition: hēdychrum ī, n , h(du/xroun, a fragrant oiniment, cosmetic balsam.

helica.definition: helica ae, f , e(li/kh, a whorl.

herbescens.definition: herbēscēns ntis, adj. herba, appearing in green blades : viriditas.

hercle.definition: hercle interj. contr. for hercule, by Hercules, assuredly, indeed : Puer herclest, T., C.

hercule.definition: hercule interj. voc. of Hercules, by Hercules, assuredly, indeed : tum hercule confitear.—Often with me : vero me hercule hoc dicam.

here.definition: here adv. for herī, yesterday , C., H., O.

heri.definition: herī adv. HES-, yesterday : quod mihi heri non licuit: heri vesperi; opp. hodie, O.— Lately, a short time ago , Ct., Pr.

heroine.definition: hēroīnē ae, f (plur. īnae, Pr.), h(rwi/nh, a demi-goddess, heroine, Pr.

hetaericos.definition: hetaericos ē, on, f , e(tairiko/s, of comrades: equitum ala (in the Macedonian army), N.

heu!.definition: heu! interj., of grief or pain, oh! ah! alas!: heu nefas! H.: heu me miserum!: heu! miser, O.: Heu me! H.: Heu! heu! V.

hexapylon.definition: hexapylon ī, n , e(ca/pulon, a gate of Syracuse with six passages, L.

hice.definition: (hice, haece, hoce) older form of hic, haec, hoc.

hiulce.definition: hiulcē adv. hiulcus, of speech, in a gaping manner, with a frequent hiatus : loqui.

horrendum.definition: horrendum adv. horrendus, dreadfully, fearfully, horribly : stridens, V.: intonet, Iu.

horride.definition: horridē adv. with comp. horridus, roughly, savagely, severely, sternly : vixit: ornamentis uti horridius: dicere, laconically .

hospitaliter.definition: hospitāliter adv. hospitalis, hospitably, as a guest : invitati, L.: vocare, L.

hostiliter.definition: hostīliter adv. hostilis, like an enemy, inimically : alquid facere: accedere, S., L., O.

humiliter.definition: humiliter adv. humilis, basely, meanly, abjectly, humbly : sentire: servire, L.

hydrops.definition: hydrōps ōpis, m , u(/drwy, the dropsy: dirus, H.

hyperboreus.definition: hyperboreus adj. , u(perbo/reos, northern, polar, arctic, V., H., O.
